[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Moving Points** [CF 1311F · Moving Points](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1311/F){rating="1900"}

Two points on the line meet (distance $0$ forever after) iff the **left one is strictly faster**: $x_i < x_j$ and $v_i > v_j$ — the gap shrinks at rate $v_i - v_j > 0$. If $v_i \le v_j$ the gap never shrinks and the minimum is the initial gap $x_j - x_i$. So

$$\sum_{i<j} d(i,j) = \sum_{\substack{i<j \\ v_i \le v_j}} (x_j - x_i),$$

with $i, j$ indexing positions **sorted by $x$** (the $x$-distinctness means the sorted order is the only geometry that matters). Now it is A2's double-BIT pattern verbatim: sweep points left to right by coordinate; for the current point $j$ sum over **earlier** points with $v_i \le v_j$ the quantity $x_j - x_i$, which factors as $x_j \cdot \mathit{count} - \mathit{sumX}$. Two Fenwick trees keyed by **compressed velocity** — a count tree and an $x$-sum tree — answer each step in $O(\log n)$; velocities span $\pm 10^8$ but only $n$ of them exist.

[Solved in full in @sec-coord-p4-moving.]{.card-link}

:::
